replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design has internet-facing SAML ACS reading assertion attributes; forged assertion attack is concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"Design never mentions RelayState or post-login redirect/return URL; attack rests on unmentioned component."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design states internet-reachable admin portal gated only by SSO; credential-theft path is distinct from forgery."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design explicitly decides admin access from assertion role attribute; insider self-asserted role escalation is concrete."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Replay of captured assertion to internet-facing ACS is a distinct attack from forgery."},{"id":"T6","keep":false,"reason":"Signature-wrapping depends on XML parser/library implementation details, not design-stated behaviour; overlaps forged assertion.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Design says role read once after login; stale admin session for leaver is concrete and distinct."},{"id":"T8","keep":true,"reason":"Design names admin login and admin access decisions but no audit log; repudiation is specific here."}]}
